Cross-Mode Parity Fixture

This page is rendered identically by URL/iframe mode and console-snippet mode because it is a complete self-contained document with only inline CSS and no external network requests.

Readable content

This paragraph uses a medium gray on white and comfortably passes the WCAG AA contrast threshold for normal body text at sixteen pixels.

White text on blue

White text on a saturated blue surface, well above the four point five to one minimum.

Low-contrast examples

This light gray text on white does not meet the contrast minimum and should be flagged as a failure by the contrast scorer.

This near-tone gray text on a light gray panel is even harder to read and is a second deliberate contrast failure.
